name: When should I repair a drywall crack myself versus hiring a professional?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair a drywall crack myself versus hiring a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small, hairline cracks, often found near windows or doors, can usually be repaired with joint compound and paint by a homeowner. However, if cracks are wider than a quarter-inch, long, recurring, or accompanied by water stains or bulging, it's best to consult a professional. These signs can indicate underlying structural problems or water damage that require expert assessment and repair to prevent further, more costly issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair small hairline cracks yourself. For wider, recurring, or water-stained cracks, hire a professional to assess potential underlying issues.
